name: Yumesaki Shuu
source:
The protagonist, a third year of high school. Has retired from his club activity and living his days worrying about the carreer he's going to choose. While looking for a new goal, he met Tomoe. 

Basically a good person, someone who can't leave other people in trouble alone. Due to that, he's often carry problems by himself, but he lives with the help by other people around him.
